d:
[Branded Content] A city built on hills, streets that turn into staircases, and a scooter taking on a challenge unlike any other.
We take the Hero Xoom 125 to Aizawl, Mizoram, to navigate its steep slopes, narrow alleys and seemingly endless stairways. From the first drop to the steepest section of the city, the Xoom 125 takes on a route that wasn't exactly designed for a scooter.
With its 14-inch wheels and telescopic front forks, we put the Hero Xoom 125 through a rather unusual ride in one of India's most distinctive cities.
